backgrounds.name: the flow
backgrounds.description: Space round two black holes of one solar mass each, 1 AU apart, flowing as a potential flow: its speed sqrt(2GM/d1 + 2GM/d2) from the two potentials added, and no swirl, so that it runs down the paths of things falling from rest far away (worked out exactly for two bodies). The grey arrows are the flow u, the dark ones g, its acceleration, which is Newton's gravity. Each hole has a region of its own, filled by the paths that fall into it; the dashed line is the seam where the two regions meet, through the point half way between, where g is zero.

layers.label: the seam, where the bodies' regions of flow meet
